I still have the scar.''"<br />"''Begging your pardon, Duchess, I distinctly remember carrying you to safety.''"<br />"''I meant the scar I got after you fell and dropped me.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]|<ref name="VoT">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref>}}
'''Draboon''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TCWIV" /> located within the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]], in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Situated within the eponymous [[Draboon system/Legends|Draboon system]],<ref name="TEAOC" /> Draboon was a source of high-quality [[Lapis/Legends|lapis]].<ref name="TCWIV" />

During his youth as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprenticed to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his master were tasked with protecting the young [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Duke/Legends|duchess]], [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. Though the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] spent a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="VoT" /> the Mandalorian people's cultural [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="TEA" /> their mission eventually brought them to Draboon, where Kenobi was forced to defended Kryze against a swarm of [[Venom-mite/Legends|venom-mites]]. The Jedi Padawan managed to successfully evade the mites, carrying the Duchess to safety, but Kryze was ultimately left with a scar after Kenobi accidentally fell and dropped her on the ground during the altercation.<ref name="VoT" /> As an adult, Duchess Kryze's private [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']], was furnished with fine lapis from Draboon.<ref name="TCWIV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Draboon was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the thirteen episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, entitled "[[Voyage of Temptation]]," which aired [[February 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="VoT" /> [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] detailed the planet's location in the galaxy,<ref name="TEAOC" /> and Draboon was later mentioned in the television series' reference book, ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''.<ref name="TCWIV" />
